29f7af.title: Nuxt dev source disclosure confirmed
29f7af.content: Live 3002 behaves as Nuxt dev server. Unauthenticated `/` HTML references `/_nuxt/@fs/...` and `/_nuxt/@vite/client`. GET `/_nuxt/@fs/Users/heyrcg/Documents/Works/gioi/apps/web/nuxt.config.ts` and `app.vue`, pages/index.vue, server/middleware/host-routes.ts return 200 transformed source. `/_nuxt/@vite/client` returns 179896 bytes. `/@vite/client` without `/_nuxt` is 404. `/@fs/etc/passwd` and API `.env` are 403, indicating root restriction but not app-source protection. Config lines 5-7 bind dev host using `NUXT_DEV_HOST` and enable devtools; production should run `nuxt build` + preview/output, not dev.
